entities.name: Kedarick
entities.description: The king of Iretis, who writes letters to his estranged wife Klytessa while brokering a peace treaty with the leonin.

entities.name: Klytessa
entities.description: Kedarick's wife, who came from Meletis and left him; the recipient of his letters.

entities.name: Lara
entities.description: The daughter of Kedarick and Klytessa, who left with her mother.

entities.name: Udaen
entities.description: Kedarick's sage counselor, recovered from near-death with astonishing vitality, who handles negotiations with the leonin tribes and saves the king from Thoros.

entities.name: Thoros Clawkiller
entities.description: Kedarick's friend of thirty years and a prominent expansionist, who claims a monster killed his nephew, then tries to stab the king and is executed.

entities.name: Teralos
entities.description: Thoros's nephew, whose severed head Thoros claims was torn off by a four-armed, two-headed cat.

entities.name: Iretis
entities.description: Kedarick's kingdom, living in the shadow of Meletis and in conflict with the leonin.

entities.name: Meletis
entities.description: The wondrous city from which Klytessa came, whose shadow Iretis seeks to escape.

entities.name: Greenhills settlement
entities.description: An outer settlement where Thoros is the largest landowner, with claims on land sought from the leonin.

entities.name: Leonin
entities.description: The cat-folk who live in tribes and are about to sign a peace treaty with Iretis.

entities.name: Expansionists
entities.description: Settlers of Iretis' outer settlements who want more land and oppose peace with the leonin.

entities.name: Impossible monsters
entities.description: Ferocious monsters reported by outer settlements, whose bodies vanish into dust or mist; one is described as having four arms and two heads.

events.summary: Kedarick writes to his estranged wife Klytessa about the coming peace with the leonin.
events.quote: The formal signing with the leonin is in a fortnight.

events.summary: Outer settlements report impossible monsters whose bodies vanish; Kedarick and Udaen suspect expansionist sabotage.
events.quote: The expansionists always want more land, and they see this potential peace as a direct blow to their dreams of expansion.

events.summary: Kedarick remembers the day with Klytessa and baby Lara by the lake and the night after.
events.quote: We spent the day at the lake, splashing and walking and talking

events.summary: Thoros Clawkiller arrives at the throne room and presents the severed head of his nephew, claiming the leonin killed him.
events.quote: Thoros put his hand into a satchel and pulled out a head.

events.summary: Thoros describes a four-armed, two-headed cat that appeared in the scout camp, killed Teralos and ten others, then vanished into mist.
events.quote: It had four arms, two heads, and teeth and claws as long as daggers.

events.summary: Thoros demands justice and asks why Kedarick seeks peace with those who kill his people; the king has no answer.
events.quote: "Justice for Teralos. Justice for the dead. Justice for the living.

events.summary: Udaen points out that Thoros stands to lose land if peace holds; Kedarick promises an investigation.
events.quote: Thoros was my friend, and my compatriot in battle, but he also stood to lose much if the peace with the leonin held.

events.summary: Thoros attacks Kedarick with a dagger; Udaen trips him with his staff and Thoros's men are slaughtered.
events.quote: Udaen was there, interposing his frail body between myself and Thoros, shouting, "For the King!"

events.summary: Thoros says others told him the king had gone blind in his quest for peace; he seems dazed as if he had not intended the attack.
events.quote: They seemed as surprised by the attempt as I had been.

events.summary: Kedarick executes his friend Thoros Clawkiller by beheading him.
events.quote: I had my eyes wide open as I passed judgment on Thoros Clawkiller, my friend.

events.summary: Udaen hands Kedarick a secret letter; Kedarick gives a triumphant speech before the signing, insisting the rumors of terrors are ephemeral.
Udaen reports that Thoros's kin have gathered a small army of several hundred men from the settlements.
events.quote: Thoros's brothers and sons had gathered a small army of several hundred men from the settlements.

events.summary: Kedarick believes his secret means Klytessa and Lara are returning, and looks to a new age for Iretis.
events.quote: You are coming back. You are coming back!

relations.quote: I was the king, trying to forge a peace
The last speech I had given was shortly after you left

relations.note: Udaen is the king's trusted counselor and main factor.
relations.quote: I have put that vitality to good use, making him my main factor in the dealings with the various tribes.
He has saved my life against the cats many times.
It was a major victory, to have such a prominent expansionist come around to the side of peace.

relations.note: Klytessa came to Iretis from Meletis.
relations.quote: I remember that day you first arrived from Meletis.
